## Outcome

Describe the implemented result and link the existing plan item.

## Validation

List exact commands, actual results and omitted checks with reasons.

## Self-review

Record correctness/diff review and adversarial security/privacy/money review.

## Independent review

Record the separate non-author reviewer session, exact reviewed commit, role,
findings and evidence. This is procedural AI separation, not two-human approval.
Do not merge while required findings remain unresolved.

## Risks, rollout and rollback

Describe the changed behavior, safety boundaries and reversal.
